node.label: texte
node.hasNote: A resource consisting primarily of words for reading. Examples include books, letters, dissertations, poems, newspapers, articles, archives of mailing lists. Note that facsimiles or images of texts are still of the genre Text. [Source: http://purl.org/dc/dcmitype/Text]

node.label: ouvrage/monographie
node.hasNote: A non-serial publication that is complete in one volume or a designated finite number of volumes. [Source: Adapted from http://purl.org/eprint/type/Book]

node.label: chapitre de livre/partie d'ouvrage
node.hasNote: A defined chapter or section of a book, usually with a separate title or number. [Source: http://purl.org/spar/fabio/BookChapter]
